dataset: datasets/usgs_hivis_stage (USGS HIVIS images + NWIS gauge height 00065; US public domain)
protocol: Per site, frames sorted by time. Reference frame = first frame. Calibration split = earliest 25% of frames; test = remaining 75%. Each method's waterline position along the strip is mapped to stage by a robust (Theil-Sen) 2-parameter line fitted on that method's own calibration-split outputs. Thresholds and estimator code are frozen from the synthetic train split.

NY_East_Branch_Delaware_River_at_Hancock.scene: close-up staff gauge on a concrete wall, numerals in feet (10-20 ft)
NY_East_Branch_Delaware_River_at_Hancock.numeral_note: Pixel centres of the printed foot numerals read from the 2026-07-27 08:00 EDT frame; mark stage = numeral + datum offset (1 parameter, fitted on the calibration split).

NY_Genesee_River_at_Avon_Staff_Gage.scene: narrow staff gauge on a stone bridge abutment, far from the camera
NY_Genesee_River_at_Avon_Staff_Gage.physical_scope_note: Out of scope for physical calibration: the staff plates (numerals 20s-44) use a different datum from NWIS gauge height and sit above the water for almost the whole event; the water reaches the lowest plate only near the peak.

NY_Owasco_Inlet_below_Aurora_Street_at_M.scene: free-standing staff gauge mid-channel; fully submerged near the peak; camera reframed after 2026-09-03
NY_Owasco_Inlet_below_Aurora_Street_at_M.numeral_note: Plate-centre pixel positions (720x405 frame coordinates) of the printed 8.00/7.00/6.00/5.00/4.00 ft numerals, read from the full-resolution HIVIS 'overlay' image of 2026-08-31 12:00Z (3840x2160, scaled by 720/3840). No gauge readings were used.

IL_Vermilion_River_near_Danville.scene: bank and bridge, no staff gauge or fixed vertical reference in view

IN_White_River_at_Michigan_Street_at_Ind.scene: wide river view, no staff gauge in view

TX_White_Rk_Ck_at_Greenville_Ave_Dallas.scene: wide creek view from a bridge, no staff gauge; view changes after 2026-10-01

physical_protocol: Physical calibration (what an installer does): click the printed numerals on ONE reference frame and enter their values. stage_m = numeral_ft x 0.3048 with NO fitted parameters and NO gauge readings used, so every frame of the site is a held-out test frame. Estimator code and thresholds are frozen from the synthetic train split. In-range frames: truth within the marked span +/- 5 cm. Out-of-range frames (water below the gauge foot or gauge submerged) score as correct if the reading is clamped within 10 cm of the nearest gauge end.
